name: LabelEncodeNode
label: Label Encode
description: Converts a categorical column into integer labels (0-based). Distinct values are assigned integers sorted alphabetically. Optionally replaces the source column or adds a new column.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DataTable
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The data table containing the categorical column to encode.

fields.name: ColumnToEncode
fields.label: Column To Encode
fields.description: The categorical column to label encode.

fields.name: ResultColumnName
fields.label: Result Column Name
fields.description: The name of the new encoded column. Defaults to '<Column>_Label'.

fields.name: ReplaceSourceColumn
fields.label: Replace Source Column
fields.description: True to replace the source column with the labels. Defaults to false (adds a new column).

fields.name: EncodedDataTable
fields.label: Encoded Data Table
fields.description: The resulting data table with the encoded column.
